title: Pure-tensor and derived-counit normalized operation scalar transport
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E,L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-embedding $\iota:E\to L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $W$ be a scheme, and write $R_E,R_L$ for its completed coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], $\phi:R_E\to R_L$ for the canonical coefficient map [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], and $\operatorname{Mod}(R_E)$ for the completed-coefficient module category [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Let $F=\mathrm{integralOrdinaryScalar}_{\iota,W}$ and $D(F)$ be its exact termwise derived functor [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Let $G=\mathrm{pbcExtend}_{\phi}$ and $LG=\mathrm{pbcDerivedExtend}_{\phi}$ be the ordinary sheafified tensor and its universal left-derived functor, with universal complex counit $\epsilon_P:LG(QP)\to Q(GP)$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. An operation scalar transport is the datum of natural isomorphisms $o:F\xrightarrow{\sim}G$ and $d:D(F)\xrightarrow{\sim}LG$ with the following two normalizations. On every pro-etale test object $U$, every $M\in\operatorname{Mod}(R_E)$ and all sections $s\in R_L(U)$, $x\in M(U)$, $o_M$ sends the sheafified pure tensor $s\otimes x$ in $F(M)$ to that same sheafified pure tensor in $G(M)$. For every cochain complex $P$ of $R_E$-modules, $\epsilon_P\circ d_{QP}=Q(o_P)\circ\eta^F_P$, where $\eta^F_P:D(F)(QP)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q(FP)$ is the canonical factorization for the exact termwise functor. This defines a type of normalized comparison data and asserts no existence or uniqueness theorem.
